repairs.finding: Conditional monotone derivative rows were cached and returned as mutable arrays. A caller could change a future derivative answer through that array.
repairs.correction: The privately cached rows, call bindings and registry metadata are deeply frozen. Diagnostics return immutable copies. Mutation controls are included in the new helper tests.
repairs.historicalScope: Earlier execution tests passed without this newly added mutation control. Their exact receipts stay unchanged and do not count as tests of the repaired bytes.

repairs.finding: Shared independent-reader integral substitution could capture an actual argument having the same coordinate as the integration binder. integral_0^1 exp(r*eta)dr at eta=caller r could incorrectly become integral exp(r^2)dr.
repairs.correction: The local integration binder is alpha-renamed before inserting an arbitrary argument. Integral endpoints remain outside the binder scope. The direct regression also retains moving-endpoint dependence in integral_0^Z exp(r*Z)dr at Z=caller r; its derivative contains both the nonzero integral and endpoint exp(r^2).
repairs.historicalScope: The reviewer reproduced the defect before publication or source-count promotion. Earlier runs are preserved as limited observations; a fresh replay records the repaired bytes.

resourceChange.reason: The independently derived implicit equation expansion requires additional measured finite work. The new run reaches a real unsupported maximum-selection gate instead of treating it as zero.
